text:
Alejandra: heads-up — onboarding gptx-3 v2 weights. local eval shows extra trailing tokens when using the usual chat template. I think BOS/EOS behavior changed. weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/gptx-3/v2/ (sha256: d2f3b9...)
Samir: which tokenizer did you load? new vocab or same as v1?
Alejandra: loading tokenizer from model repo: models/gptx-3/tokenizer.json in that S3 path. quick diff shows special tokens changed: v1 used '<|user|>' and '<|assistant|>' while v2 has '<|human|>' and '<|bot|>'.
Tim: ah — runtime assumes `bos_token":"` (empty string) and `eos_token":"` by default. if tokenizer has explicit special tokens we need to set `add_bos`/`add_eos` in model_config or the chat template will double-insert.
Ellen: can you paste the model_config.json? I can add a small validation to catch missing bos/eos fields.
Alejandra: here's the current snippet from the repo:
```json
{
  "model_name": "gptx-3",
  "use_chat_format": true,
  "tokenizer": "tokenizer.json",
  "quant": "q4_0",
  "kernel_profile": "default"
}
```
Samir: add these fields 
```json
"bos_token": "",
"eos_token": "",
"special_tokens": {"user": "<|human|>", "assistant": "<|bot|>"}
```
and set `use_chat_format` semantics so runtime knows not to prepend an extra BOS when special_tokens are present.
Tim: also watch for `add_prefix_space` interactions (spaces in tokenization change leading-token counts). we saw an off-by-one in kv-cache indexing on a recent model when prefix space semantics changed.
Ellen: I'll open a small PR to add schema validation and a unit test. test plan: encode("\nUser: hi\nAssistant:") roundtrip, assert that encoded tokens end with the expected eos token if configured. command to run locally:
```
python -m tests.tokenizer_roundtrip --model s3://redwood-models/onboard/gptx-3/v2/ --case "chat_template"
```
I'll include the exact JSON schema check for `bos_token`/`eos_token`/`special_tokens`.
Alejandra: PR would be great. pinging @Tim and @Samir for review when ready. Also can someone ask deploy-bot to verify weights manifest + size? I want to ensure runtime gets same artifacts as local.
deploy-bot: checking s3://redwood-models/onboard/gptx-3/v2/ ...
deploy-bot: found objects: weights-000.bin (1.2GB), weights-001.bin (1.1GB), tokenizer.json (245KB), model_config.json (2.1KB), manifest.json (1.6KB)
deploy-bot: manifest sha256: d2f3b9a7... matches expected in release notes? NO -> manifest reported: d2f3b9a7... (expected d2f3b9a7...), sizes ok but manifest last_modified differs (2026-11-02T14:12:03Z).
Samir: hmm manifest mismatch could be a metadata-only rewrite, but still worth re-uploading or fixing manifest in release pipeline. if manifest changed, runtime might pick different tokenizer mapping.
Ellen: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4321 — adds schema validation and a new test. I ran tests locally, they passed aside from the eos assert failing once — shows the tokenizer produced an extra eos token for empty assistant prompt. log attached in PR.
Tim: idea: add a short gating check in the onboarding pipeline that runs `python -c "from tokenizer import load; print(load(path).special_tokens)"` and fails if special_tokens keys mismatch expected chat keys. that'll catch this early.
Alejandra: sounds good. Samir — if you can look at the manifest mismatch and confirm it's safe to proceed, I'll queue a canary deploy for tomorrow.
Samir: will look tonight. quick note: when you run inference in the runtime, use `--preserve-bos false` if model_config provides explicit bos; short-term workaround until the config validator is merged.
qa-bot: automated test run for PR-4321: tokenizer_roundtrip -> FAIL (eos token extra) ; full logs: http://ci.internal/4321/logs/tokenizer_roundtrip.txt
Ellen: saw the CI failure, investigating. likely the tokenizer loads special tokens in a slightly different order which makes our naive suffix assert brittle. I'll make the test compare token ids for the expected special token rather than string suffix.
Alejandra: thanks all. final ask — small code review + manifest check before I kick canary. :thumbsup:
Tim: ack, will review PR-4321 tonight.
Samir: ack, will verify manifest and bump if needed.
Ellen: will update tests and push fix in the morning.
deploy-bot: scheduled artifact checksum revalidation in 2h.
